messages:
emily: Pager fired — embeddings service /v1/embed showing ~60% 5xx in us-west. Notified SREs and started triage. @oncall :rotating_light:
incident-bot: incident-bot: PagerDuty alert: embeddings-high-error (sev2). Channel created: #inc-1769123456. Pages: emily, raj.
raj: I'm on it. Tailing the model-runtime logs, seeing a bunch of redis connection errors and eviction spikes during the cleanup job. Looks like cache thrash -> 502s from runtime.
emily: Scaling redis from 3 -> 5 nodes and temporarily disabling aggressive eviction. Running scaling now.
nicole: Support: flagging enterprise customers AcmeCorp and WrapCo. Notifying TSMs and CS leads.
mike: Quick mitigation: switched 30% of traffic to us-east replica for non-dedicated traffic to reduce pressure in us-west. Will keep monitoring.
sarah: Product check: any quick feature flags to lower embedding sampling rate for bulk jobs? Could drop non-critical jobs to reduce load.
alex: Added temporary edge rate limit 200 req/s for anonymous pipelines to blunt incoming spike.
incident-bot: incident-bot: Handoff scheduled in 30m at 18:30 UTC. Current on-call -> raj. Please post status.
emily: Handoff notes: root suspicion = redis eviction thrash coinciding with nightly cleanup job. Mitigation steps applied, error rate down to ~2%. Logging full request ids to trace affected customers.
raj: I'll run the postmortem. Scheduling 1h postmortem tomorrow 15:00 UTC. Please invite infra, eng-runtime, product, SRE, and support. @sarah @nicole can you attend?
sarah: I'll join. Need a clear customer impact summary for AcmeCorp/WrapCo for the comms.
nicole: Support will produce incident window and affected endpoints list. ETA: +2h for initial doc.
emily: Drafting action items here so we can size/prioritize before the PM: 
- Action 1: Fix Redis eviction/regulator to prevent thrash (owner: alex) — estimate: medium (2-3d) — priority: P0
- Action 2: Add circuit-breaker / failover path to us-east at runtime (owner: mike) — estimate: small (1d) — priority: P0
- Action 3: Postmortem writeup + customer communication (owner: nicole + sarah) — estimate: small (0.5d) — priority: P1
- Action 4: Add e2e test for background cleanup job to catch regression (owner: raj) — estimate: medium (3d) — priority: P1
- Action 5: Q2 planning: reserve extra capacity and update runbooks (owner: emily) — estimate: large (5d) — priority: P1

alex: Ack. I'll scope the redis fix and pair with infra. Will open a Jira and mark P0 — this blocks other mitigations.
mike: I'll prototype the circuit-breaker today; need to validate across routing layers. Probably 1 day + testing.
raj: For scheduling: propose sprint 1 includes Action 1 + 2; sprint 2 includes tests, runbook updates, and Q2 capacity items. PM alignment required for sprint placement.
sarah: Agreed. I'll add the runbook/update and capacity request to Q2 objectives doc and ask finance for capex/opex estimate.
nicole: Drafting customer comms now. Will coordinate with legal on wording for AcmeCorp. REDWOOD support will provide timeline.
emily: Postmortem meeting created and invite sent. Please paste Jira IDs here once created so we can track in the postmortem doc. Also link any investigation artifacts.
alex: Created REDWOOD-8421 for redis eviction fix (estimate 3d).
mike: Created REDWOOD-8432 for circuit-breaker/failover (estimate 1d).
raj: Created REDWOOD-8437 for e2e test coverage (estimate 3d).
nicole: Created REDWOOD-8440 for customer comms (estimate 0.5d).
sarah: Marking priorities: 8421 (P0), 8432 (P0), others P1. I'll add these to the quarterly plan and align with PM for sprint assignment.
emily: Thanks all — mitigation looks stable. We'll capture final action item owners/estimates in the postmortem doc. Reopening the channel if error rate spikes. :thumbsup:
